document_host.note: HP TRIM / Content Manager 'CMWebDrawer'. Fully constructible from the reference: stateless, cold, no session and no Referer, and no need to touch the register first. This is the whole retrieval route at Camden — the PE register is effectively browser-only and is not needed for documents.

reference_format.note: YYYY/NNNN with a single-letter suffix. /P is the usual one; /A and /T also occur. The suffix set was not established as closed, so no pattern is asserted.

quirks.summary: The PE register host is effectively browser-only (score-based Cloudflare, plus StdDetails 500s at origin) — but it is not needed, because documents are constructible from the reference alone.
quirks.workaround: Go straight to the CMWebDrawer document host; for the register itself, hand the user the browser_route deep link.

quirks.summary: The CMWebDrawer HTML view lists every document twice — once under its title and once as 'M3 Document' — so a scrape of it double-counts with no error.
quirks.workaround: Request &format=json, or dedupe on the record id.

quirks.summary: PlanIt's area planning_url for Camden points at the council's Socrata open-data site, not at a portal (scraper_type Custom).
quirks.detail: The usable pointers are on the applics records' other_fields: docs_url is a ready-made PlanRec link, alongside comment_url and url.
quirks.workaround: Take the portal pointers from the applics records. The Socrata dataset opendata.camden.gov.uk/resource/2eiu-s2cw.json is a usable search-by-address fallback.

quirks.summary: WAF signals present (cloudflare) but the landing page served normally.
quirks.detail: Passive at survey time. Not a reason to avoid the automated route; it is a reason to pace properly and to expect a challenge if you do not.

bot_protection.behaviour: Score-based and ENFORCING on the register host (planningrecords.camden.gov.uk): the first ~2 curl requests reach origin, then everything is challenged — including URLs that worked moments earlier. Generic/StdDetails.aspx also 500s even at origin. PASSIVE on the document host (camdocs.camden.gov.uk), where plain HTTP works normally.

browser_route.note: For the register only — documents do not need it. The redirector is a JavaScript stub, not a 302: curl -L will not follow it, so parse document.location.href out of the body.

endpoints.note: The JSON is ServiceStack-shaped: Results[].Uri is the record id that goes into the download URL, RecordTitle labels the document, Fields.PlanningDocumentType types it, and TotalResults / HasMoreItems give a real completeness check. &pageSize=N is honoured.

source_notes: Register is Northgate PE on NEC-rebranded paths (/NECSWS/PlanningExplorer/) but YOU NEVER NEED IT: documents are on HP TRIM (Content Manager) 'CMWebDrawer' at camdocs.camden.gov.uk — constructible from the ref alone, stateless, cold, no Referer. (1) GET /CMWebDrawer/PlanRec?q=recContainer:%22<enc-ref>%22&format=json -> ServiceStack JSON: Results[].Uri (record id), RecordTitle, Fields.PlanningDocumentType, TotalResults/HasMoreItems (real completeness check; &pageSize=N honoured). (2) GET /CMWebDrawer/Record/<Uri>/file/document?inline -> application/pdf. HTML view lists each doc twice (title + 'M3 Document') — dedupe on record id. WAF: camdocs = passive Cloudflare; planningrecords = SCORE-BASED enforcing Cloudflare (first ~2 curl requests reach origin, then everything challenged incl. previously-working URLs) + StdDetails 500s even at origin — register is browser-only, fallback deep link …/NECSWS/Redirection/redirect.aspx?linkid=EXDC&PARAM0=<pk> (NB: that redirector is a JS stub, not a 302 — parse document.location.href). PlanIt areas planning_url is USELESS (points at Socrata open data, scraper_type Custom) — the applics records' other_fields (docs_url = ready PlanRec link, comment_url, url) are the real portal pointers. Socrata dataset opendata.camden.gov.uk/resource/2eiu-s2cw.json is a search-by-address fallback. Ref format YYYY/NNNN/P (also /A, /T).
